name: ion-protein-complex-molecular
description: 260 atoms at +21.69 e on the shared surface. The corpus's densest charge at 0.0834 e/atom — serum-albumin carries more in total at -30 e but 51x less per atom — and a united-atom structure with no hydrogens at all, which is a second radius dialect (see `hca-molecular`). Both properties are why it is the worst cross-flavour DelPhi case, at 1.257%.
